decisions.subject: Reference geometry derivation for ROW, easements, wetland, and street edges

value.method: dimensioned and visually digitized from City Appendix A maps against City GIS taxlot coordinates

decisions.rationale: The official appendix confirms location and dimensions but expressly labels mapped GIS data imprecise/general-reference. Geometry is frozen for repeatable test data without claiming survey authority.

decisions.subject: Reviewed-assumption apartment building and pad footprint
decisions.rationale: A compact 45-by-90-foot bar follows the prior research concept, fits east of the reference wetland and west of the reference ROW, and avoids all modeled constraints. Clearances prove geometry separation only; they are not code setbacks or approvals.

decisions.subject: Exterior entries and future utility wall terminals
decisions.rationale: Stable wall interfaces let later systems connect to one building contract without implying routes, sizes, capacities, inverts, or approved penetrations.

decisions.subject: Minimum fictional vertical basis for the sanitary gravity envelope

value.reference_surface_method: low-confidence profile anchored to City GIS manhole rims and extrapolated to the building terminal

decisions.rationale: The mock gravity system needs an explicit elevation envelope. The provisional FFE and extrapolated surface are deliberately reviewable assumptions; City GIS NAVD88 rims/inverts remain reference-derived and do not create project control.

decisions.subject: Fictional sanitary service alignment, material, and assumed public connection
decisions.rationale: A short westward run to a two-way cleanout and a straight northward run to the crossing main creates maintainable topology without inventing a site manhole. The 6-inch PVC SDR35 and 1.0% slope are reviewed mock defaults from the cited constraint ledger. The connection is a test assumption pending potholing, survey, City approval, and capacity review.

decisions.subject: Fictional roof-drainage hydrologic screening basis
decisions.rationale: The complete reviewed building roof area is conservatively treated as impervious for deterministic test-data arithmetic. These volumes are screening quantities, not a routed hydrograph, capacity approval, or compliance finding.

decisions.subject: Minimum fictional vertical basis for roof and storm gravity routing
decisions.rationale: The mock network reuses the provisional FFE and establishes an explicit generated surface envelope tied to reference City GIS rim context. It is sufficient only to test positive gravity, cover, and conflicts; survey control, final grading, capacity, and HGL remain unresolved.

decisions.subject: Lined extended-filtration planter and flow-control test objects
decisions.rationale: A compact lined planter provides a real treatment/topology object and exceeds the simple water-quality volume screen. It is intentionally not credited for infiltration and is undersized for the unrouted 10-year roof-volume screen; routing, overflow, geotechnical suitability, and agency acceptance remain unknown.

decisions.subject: Fictional roof and storm conveyance alignment to City reference context
decisions.rationale: Two permanent roof leaders combine at the existing building terminal, pass through a lined planter and flow-control structure, and connect through an external-drop site manhole to an assumed point at the reference 21-inch City main. The alignment preserves a modeled storm-below-sanitary clearance but requires survey/potholing and owner review.
